text:
Alicia M: Quick sync — proposing we move the token counter into the composer toolbar so users can watch usage while streaming. Mock here: https://redwood.design/proto/token-toolbar-preview :eyes:
Samir K: Makes sense for visibility. My worry is layout churn when numbers update rapidly. Could we keep a fixed pill width and animate the digits inside? Collapse to icon-only while streaming? :thinking_face:
Marta P: Accessibility: do NOT announce every token update to SRs. Use an aria-live polite region and debounce. Announce only important transitions: generation started, interrupted, complete with final token count. Also add a clear accessible name for the token control and focus styles when keyboarding.
Zoe L: UX: wording for the interrupt control matters. "Pause" implies resume; we don't support resume. Recommend label "Stop" and tooltip "Stop generation — partial result preserved". Show Esc as the shortcut hint.
Samir K: Keyboard shortcuts: Esc = stop/interrupt, R = regenerate, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = submit. We'll add a help overlay showing these.
Alicia M: Token pill modes: compact (icon + short number), expanded (used / cap + est remaining). While streaming show icon-only to reduce visual noise. Tooltip provides breakdown (prompt vs response estimate).
Marta P: Implementation note: reserve the pill width so numbers don't shift layout. Example CSS: .token-pill { width:68px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; } Animate inner numbers only. SR messages: "Generation started", "Generation stopped by user", "Generation complete: X tokens used".
Zoe L: Contrast issue: current green fails for small text. Need 4.5:1. I'll post contrast-correct swatches in Figma and three placement options (left/right/inline). Running quick 6-person preference test tomorrow.
designbot: Preview deploy: https://playground-preview.red/ui/1759994321 includes compact pill, keyboard hints, and stop snackbar. Leave notes in #design-test.
Samir K: Interaction nit: when user stops, show a subtle snackbar: "Generation stopped — partial result available. Press R to regenerate." Reduces confusion.
Alicia M: Also adding a tiny quick-insert (last-used system prompt) next to the pill for power users. If it opens a dialog, ensure focus trap and Escape restores focus to composer.
Marta P: Confirm ARIA for quick-insert button and that the dialog is accessible (role=dialog, labelledby, focus trap).
Zoe L: If no objections I'll land the compact pill on the right of the toolbar and keep tab order: composer -> token pill -> send. Posting Figma variants + micro-interaction specs by EOD.
Alicia M: Thanks — next steps: Zoe posts Figma, Marta writes aria spec with exact announce strings, Samir wires shortcuts in the prototype, I'll draft tooltip and snackbar copy. :thumbsup:
